chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Muawiya ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The one performing the exclusive Hajj (Hajj al-Mufrid) upon him is a circumambulation of the House, and two cycles of prayer at the Standing Place of Ibrahim (peace be upon him), and a Sa'ee between As-Safa and Al-Marwa, and a circumambulation of the visitation, and it is the circumambulation of the women, and there is no sacrificial animal upon him, nor an offering.

He (the narrator) said, 'And I asked him (peace be upon him) about the one performing the exclusive Hajj, should he circumambulate the House after the obligatory circumambulation?' He (peace be upon him) said, 'Yes, as much as he desires, and he should renew the Talbiyya after the two cycles; and the one performing the paired Hajj (Hajj al-Qarin) is in that same status, combining what is permissible of the circumambulation with the Talbiyya.'

key_terms.التَّلْبِيَةَ: The recitation of 'Labbayk Allahumma Labbayk', a declaration of presence and readiness for Hajj rituals.
key_terms.الْقَارِنُ: The pilgrim who combines Umrah and Hajj together in a single Ihram.
key_terms.الْمُفْرِدُ بِالْحَجِّ: The exclusive Hajj pilgrim who performs Tawaf and Sa'ee for Hajj only, without Umrah.
key_terms.طَوَافُ الزِّيَارَةِ: The circumambulation of the Kaaba performed upon arrival, also known as Tawaf al-Qudum.
key_terms.طَوَافُ النِّسَاءِ: The final circumambulation of the Kaaba performed to conclude the Hajj rituals.
key_terms.هَدْيٌ: A sacrificial animal (usually a sheep, goat, cow, or camel) offered by the pilgrim.

ai.seo_question: What are the specific ritual obligations and differences between Hajj al-Mufrid and Hajj al-Qarin according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi delineates the distinct ritual framework of Hajj al-Mufrid, emphasizing the absence of the Hady (sacrifice) requirement which distinguishes it from Hajj al-Qarin and Hajj al-Tamattu'. It further clarifies the procedural nuance that while the Mufrid is permitted to perform additional Tawaf after the obligatory rites, the Qarin combines these circumambulations under a single Talbiyya, reflecting the jurisprudential consensus on the structural differences between these Hajj types.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The one performing the exclusive Hajj, upon him is a circumambulation of the House, and two Cycles by the Standing Place of Ibrahim<sup>as</sup>, and a Sa’ee between Al-Safa and Al-Marwa, and a circumambulation of the visitation, and it is a circumambulation of the women (طَوَافُ النِّسَاءِ), and there is no sacrificial animal upon him, nor an offering’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘And I asked himasws about the performer of the exclusive Hajj, should be circumambulate with the House (Kabah) after the Obligatory circumambulation?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes, whatever he so desires to, and he should renew the Talbiyya after (Praying) the two Cycles; and the performer of the pairing Hajj is with that status, holding both what is allowed from the circumambulation with the Talbiyya’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

One who performs Ifrad al-Hajj is required to perform Tawaf around the House, perform two Rak‘at Salat (prayer) near Maqam of Ibrahim ‘Alayhi al-Salam, perform Sa‘y between al-Safa’ and al-Marwah and perform Tawaf of Ziyarat which is Tawaf of women. He is not required to offer al-Hady (offering animal) or sacrifice.’

I then asked him (the Imam) about Ifrad al-Hajj; if he must perform Tawaf after obligatory Tawaf. He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, as much as he wants and repeats Talbiyah after two Rak‘at. One performing al-Qiran al-Hajj also in the same way establishes what was made free of Tawaf because of Talbiyah.’” (The above is best explained in the form of fatwa.)
